name: Emperor Xiu
source:
Young emperor of the Central Empire. Tyrant who interferes in political affairs with emotions and passionately absorbed in "entertainments" with young girls (lolis). His current main mistress is Hanitora. Very whimsical and arrogant.

He was very young, than former emperor died from the sickness, so he was crowned. He was brought up by flattering speeches of the Gamerica and UHOS, and became a tyrant. Has a big harem with three thousands of women, when empire is in need of finances.

"See, Japs?!! This is Our power!! Choke with tears, inferior nation!!!"
